name: Depth Jump
steps: Stand near the front edge of a sturdy plyometric box with feet hip-width apart and clear space ahead.
Step calmly off the edge with one foot first so you drop straight downward rather than jumping up off the box.
Land softly on both forefeet simultaneously and immediately rebound explosively straight upward as high as possible with a full arm swing.
Absorb the second landing quietly through bent hips and knees, then step back onto the box fully reset.
tips: Minimize ground contact time between landing and takeoff while keeping your knees aligned over your toes.
Use a moderate box height that allows a crisp, explosive rebound rather than a deep collapsing squat.
